maya: Quick sync — we need a quiesce window for the user_tiers migration + backfill. Proposal: 01:30-02:15 UTC, 32 shards, 4 waves of 8.
maya: I want to avoid broad rollbacks; prefer wave-level pause/rollback. Ops + DB SRE please ack watch.
jake: Ack. Recommend canary on 2 shards first, then scale to 8. Add `--max-concurrency=1` and `--batch-size=1000`.
opsbot: [bot] scheduled change window request received for 01:30-02:15 UTC. Please pin migration to lock the window.
maya: Will pin if preflight checks pass. Also set auto-pause triggers: deadlocks >=2 / 1m OR write_p95 > 300ms.
db-sre: I can wire alerts. Also recommend replica_lag > 3s for 3m as a pause condition.
jake: Good call. CLI snippets: ```
# pin and set holdpoint
deploybot pin --migration=user-tiers-2026-03 --version=20260320c --holdpoint=manual
# start canary
deploybot start --migration=user-tiers-2026-03 --wave=canary --confirm
```
maya: Preflight done: sample backfill query p95=98ms on staging, schema diff clean.
deploybot: [bot] migration user-tiers-2026-03 pinned by maya at 1741234570. Holdpoint=manual. Use `deploybot start` to begin.
jake: Starting canary now (2 shards). Monitoring: write_p95=90ms, deadlocks=0, replica_lag=0.5s.
db-sre: All green. Hold at manual gate for 5m.
maya: Manual signoff: proceed to wave 1/4.
jake: Wave 1 started. wave-size=8, wave-delay=75s, max-concurrency=1.
db-sre: Alert: transient write_p95=420ms for 90s during wave 1, deploybot auto-paused wave 1.
maya: Oof. Rollback wave 1 only or pause to investigate?
jake: Let's pause and inspect queries — prefer not to rollback immediately if it's transient. If we see locks/deadlocks, rollback that wave.
db-sre: Trace shows a hotspot on shard 5 due to an unexpected ETL txn. Killed the ETL, locks clearing.
opsbot: ETL team notified.
maya: Resume wave 1 after lag <2s for 2m. No global rollback.
deploybot: [bot] resume request queued for migration user-tiers-2026-03. Manual confirm required.
jake: Confirming resume. Resuming wave 1. Lowering wave-size to 6 for next waves and increasing delay to 120s.
db-sre: Replica lag recovered, no deadlocks.
jake: Waves 2-4 completed with reduced size. Final verification queries show processed_rows match expected counts.
maya: Unpinning migration and adding a short blurb to release notes about ETL overlap causing p95 spike and mitigation: schedule analytics off-window + default lower wave-size.
db-sre: Postmortem-ticket created INF-3301.
maya: Thanks all. Closing thread. :tada:
